name: Upload Custom Fabrics Pass!
displayDescription: Get exclusive access to the Custom Fabrics Uploader to use your own images for in-game posters, other dorm furniture, outfits, and locker decor! Design your own images / fabric then upload them to Roblox to use inside of Royale High!

name: Paintbrush Pass!
displayDescription:
The Paintbrush Pass unlocks many different features including..
💙Changing your cellphone case and keyboard colors!
❤️Paint your Roleplay Name & Heart Indicator when you type!
💛Make a colorful unique profile!
💚Paint your locker for free as many times as you want!

name: Faster Flight! (+ Custom Speeds)
displayDescription:
Customize your flight speed, from slow to very fast. Get around campus with the fastest wings! Unlocks a meter which you can use to freely adjust your flight speed. 
Feature is disabled in certain areas/ during certain minigames.

name: Special Fabric Designs✂ (7,000+ designs!)
displayDescription: Unlock 7,000+ more fabric designs (and growing) with this special gamepass to decorate your skirts, accessories, heels, dorm furniture, and diary cover! Fabrics range from velvety textures, animal prints, pretty plaids, space and ocean scenery, pizza, and many others! I will add to more designs to pass all the time, (almost monthly) just like I do with the hair colors💖

name: New Hair Colors +GLOWING Hair Pass(4,500+ colors!)
displayName: New Hair Colors +GLOWING Hair Pass(4,500+ colors!)
displayDescription:
Decorate your hair with 4,500+ different hair color options, from gorgeous ombre blends to multicolor rainbow designs, all featuring an optional soft glowing effect!
We consistently add new fun hair colors almost every month!

name: Sticker Packs Pass!
displayDescription: 40+ themed Sticker Packs with 550+ different fun stickers (and growing) to decorate your Profile Diary with! You can also place stickers in your dorm!

name: 🔮Crystal Ball Power🔮
displayDescription: NOT FOR MOBILE/IPAD/XBOX. Look into your Crystal Ball🔮 and see ANYWHERE on campus without actually being there! Specially created with Photo Editors in mind, this pass gives you a free camera/vision to capture impossible angles you couldn't reach before. INSTRUCTIONS: Do Shift+P to activate/exit. Use WASD to move the cam. Hold Shift+W to slow down for accuracy. Have fun!

name: Materials Pass!
displayDescription: Make anything in your dorm have beautiful unique effects such as neon (glowing), glittery sequins and diamond, fuzzy blanket material, or forcefield to turn anything ghostly! Pair forcefield with a fabric for a really cool result! Semi-transparent objects turned glass also look ethereal! And of course, utilize various wood patterns, corroded metal, shiny metal, plus more, or grass for a fairy garden! Works amazing with Accent Walls and Accent Floors!

name: Fly on Earth!
displayDescription: Only the most powerful of creatures do not let a silly blue and green planet hinder their flight abilities! You might even be able to reach the Princess Tower..

name: 4x Quadruple💎Diamonds Gamepass!
displayDescription:
Get QUADRUPLE (4x) the diamonds you'd normally earn*! Stack this with the 2x monthly subscription or gamepass! Maximum stack is 6x, you cannot exceed 6x! Do not buy more than 6x, it will charge you and it will NOT work!
*Works with Campus 4 Classes, homework, fulfilling needs (hunger, sleep, hygiene), picking up diamonds, and all other activities that give Experience!

name: 2x Double💎Diamonds Gamepass!
displayDescription:
Get DOUBLE (2x) the diamonds you'd normally earn*! Stack this with the 2x / 4x monthly subscription or gamepass! Maximum stack is 6x, you cannot exceed 6x! Don't buy passed 6x, it'll charge you and it won't work!
*Works with Campus 4 Classes, homework, fulfilling needs (hunger, sleep, hygiene), picking up diamonds, and all other activities that give Experience!
